title: Rumors, Petrillo, and losing his union card
summary: The drunk rumor spreads and Petrillo, using a wrongly signed contract at a Black ballroom as pretext, pulls his card, later returning it.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: So, a lot of musicians picked that up -- you know how a rumor can become a balloon---

And, a lot of people actually thought that. You know, they really thought that and that was a very bad time for me. At the union, at that time, even Petrilla, who was trying --- he even made the crack at one time that he was going to get me one way or the other---
Do you know why - apart from this accident---
No. I don't know why he had it in for me but he did at that point and, uh, through---
You had missed jobs - you hadn't done anything that---

No, I just did that thing out at the ballroom - the colored ballroom - a one Sunday night job and when the contract was signed, it was signed a Class B -- which I signed. And, everybody got paid, but it was a wrong contract and I corrected it and give the guys their extra money; the ballroom had to do that; it was a first class job. Now just because I did that technicality -- gave him a little room to say 'he is out of the union'---
Even though everybody got their money and there weren't any questions---
No - no questions. And, then, I think he thought this was a good opportunity---
Now, this was before or after the Tesh accident--

And, uh, he jerked my card--- now, that was a very sad thing and, of course, later - not too much later - he gave it back to me because he realized he was wrong. He was absolutely wrong to do it and all my friends - said, oh, man -- this is--- they don't kick you out of the union for something you didn't do---
